candidate_semantics: push_scale multiplies player push_multiplier only, not BASE_PUSH constant/ledge threshold; slip_scale multiplies material slip gain only, recovery unchanged; drain_scale overrides slope drain multiplier only
clock_semantics: controller elapsed includes runaway descent; excludes menus, purchase selection, retry UI and loading time

notes: Entry fixtures are local physical/input experiments, not full-route completions or purchased progression.
Each physical setting and policy uses paired seeds101/202/303; gates are drySTONE even with naturalweather.
All single-factor conditions relative to G123_REF except rate/minimum variants relative to T6. G150_B40/G190_B80 are separately labeled compounded hypotheses.
stop_after_m produces diagnostic_target, not summit. Timeouts are censored, not falls.

controller: production BoulderController inherited without copied integration
growth_system: existing Progression only: cumulative nonspend EXP grants upgrade points; each existing stat rank adds 2%
timeout_handling: right-censored; campaigns stop at first run timeout, never reinterpret timeout as fall

patches: var slip_recovery: float = 20.0 if safe else (10.0 if absf(velocity) < 0.01 else (4.0 if not (exert and pushing) else 0.0))
var recovery: float = 10.0 if safe else (7.0 if absf(velocity) < 0.01 else (3.0 if degrees <= 10.0 else 0.0))
recovery_semantics: Test-only finite environmental released-recovery time. Rank-independent seconds quota; eligible time consumed even at stamina cap. Amount=rate*existing recovery_multiplier*eligible_dt clamped by actual missing stamina. No refund on retreat/reentry/stall; fresh run resets quota.
